prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1356; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording like this, but you can list me as the claimant on the file.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the collision happened?
A: It was in a parking lot at a shopping center in Sugar Land, Texas. I was backing out of a space near the main entrance.

Q: What happened just before the impact?
A: I checked my mirrors, saw nothing behind me, and started reversing slowly. About two seconds later I felt the other car hit the rear corner of my vehicle. It came in from the right side of the aisle.

Q: Were you moving quickly?
A: No, I was barely rolling. Maybe walking speed.

Q: Did you see the other driver before the impact?
A: No. Their vehicle was partly hidden by a column between our spaces.

Q: What injuries are you reporting?
A: I have neck pain and stiffness. I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon and was told I have a neck strain. I've been wearing a soft collar when I drive and I've had trouble turning my head to the left.

Q: Have you seen anyone else for the neck since then?
A: I'm scheduled to see my family doctor next week. The urgent care gave me some anti-inflammatory medication and a referral.

Q: Do you have any prior neck problems?
A: Nothing serious. I had some stiffness a few years back after sleeping wrong, but it resolved on its own.

Q: Is there anything else you want to add?
A: Only that I'd like the damage estimate to reflect the rear quarter panel and the bumper bracket, since I noticed both after the car was moved.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thanks.
